component.name: MDJ Music Downloader
component.summary: Download music into tidy, numbered albums

description.p: MDJ Music Downloader is a simple app for saving music and videos from YouTube and many other sites. It is made for music collectors: build a queue of songs, name an album, and the tracks are saved into their own folder with track numbers and a playlist, ready for your music player or MP3 player.

ul.li: Download as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV audio, or MP4 video up to 4K
Numbered download queue: add many links and download them in order
Album folders with automatic track numbers (01, 02, 03…) that continue when you add songs later
Cover art and title, artist, album and track tags for music players, phones and car stereos
Songs you already have are skipped
Export and import queue lists to back them up or share them with friends
Simple settings for everyday choices, and any yt-dlp option for advanced users

description.p: Downloads are powered by yt-dlp. Only download content you have the right to download, and respect copyright and each site's terms of service.

screenshot.caption: Downloading a queue of songs into an album folder
yt-dlp Settings: audio format, video quality and cover art

description.p: During a playlist download, each song gets its cover, tags and track number as soon as it is saved, and the album playlist grows with every song. Songs finished before Cancel keep them. A failed download shows a short reason with a Details button for the full message and a Copy button.
Songs now show their cover in the file manager even when the folder was open during the download.
Failed downloads in the queue now say why: the summary names the reason, and pointing at a song's ✗ shows the full message. Every failed download is also written to an error log.

A new yt-dlp Settings window with everyday choices (audio format, video quality, cover art) and a checked Advanced tab. Track numbering now continues correctly in existing album folders, songs you already have are not downloaded again, and a link to one song in a playlist downloads only that song.
Songs get cover art and tags that music players, phones and car stereos understand, and album folders get a cover picture. The queue is numbered, and Export and Import remember the album name.
You can keep adding songs while a queue is downloading, Cancel always stops the download, and a new teal colour scheme matches the app icon. Also fixes several freezes.
Fixes downloads failing on Ubuntu 22.04 and Linux Mint 21.
New Ko-fi link for supporting development.
